reason: Our whole operating system lives in Notion with templates we spent weeks building, plus Slack and our task app, and the Monday call already tells us who's on what. Moving all of that for $20 a month when money is tight and nothing is actually broken isn't something I'd push on my co-founder.
objection: We'd lose our Notion setup and templates, and rebuilding everything in a new tool would eat days we don't have, for a problem our Monday call mostly solves already.
would_change_my_mind: A one-click Notion import that brings our pages and templates over intact, so trying it costs us an afternoon instead of a week.
